data.name: Francis
data.gender_notes: Francis is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin Franciscus, 'Frenchman', from the Franks. Its root is Latin Franciscus. Saint Francis of Assisi. Francis is a Latin name meaning “Frenchman; free one”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Francis expresses “Frenchman; free one”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin Franciscus, 'Frenchman', from the Franks.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Francis total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
